facts.fact: Rogue 强制 Kayla 停班一周，声明不可谈判
facts.anchor: This is non-negotiable. I could have fired you, but I didn’t

facts.fact: Kayla 被黄色花送回前任 Aaron 的道歉表演史：道歉是控制手段
facts.anchor: Aaron used to bring me flowers to say sorry, but he was never truly sorry; it was a performance, a way to keep me quiet and sweep our issues under the rug

facts.fact: Aaron 以赞美启动、逐步改写 Kayla 的穿着，操纵在不知不觉中生效
facts.anchor: Without realizing it, I dressed in clothes he wanted me to wear, but I was so blind to his manipulation

facts.fact: Kayla 区分 Vero 与 Aaron：危险不同，但失控那夜她重新体验了无控制感
facts.anchor: Not because I think Vero is dangerous to me like Aaron was, but because Vero loves hard

facts.fact: Vesper 翻窗亲口交代：Vero 爬上屋顶不下来，她把他推了下去、Karo 垫子接住
facts.anchor: I pushed him off. It was the highlight of my week watching him fall

facts.fact: 花是 Vero 挑的：黄色在 Brawley 的说法里象征友谊，Vesper 直言不懂谁要和 Vero 做朋友
Vesper 声明她为 Brawley 而非 Vero 而来，并警告 Kayla 快逃
facts.anchor: I would run if I were you. I’m not here because I care about him—I care about Brawley

facts.fact: Vesper 留下判断：Vero 不会很快从这次里走出来，怎么用这信息不是她的事
facts.anchor: He won’t come out of this one quickly
